command_rows.command:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md
sed -n '1,240p' tools/make_inventory.py
sed -n '1,240p' data/stock.csv
sed -n '1,240p' reports/inventory-summary.txt
git status --short
git log --all --date=iso-strict --format='commit %H%nAuthor: %an <%ae>%nAuthorDate: %aI%nCommitDate: %cI%nSubject: %s' --name-status
stat -c '%n | type=%F | size=%s | mtime=%y | ctime=%z | birth=%w | inode=%i' README.md tools/make_inventory.py data/stock.csv reports/inventory-summary.txt
(getfattr -d -m- reports/inventory-summary.txt data/stock.csv tools/make_inventory.py 2>&1 || true)
findmnt -T reports/inventory-summary.txt -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .gitignore
git check-ignore -v reports/inventory-summary.txt || true
git ls-files -s
ls -la
ls -la reports data tools
command -v whyfs || true
command -v why || true
compgen -c | rg -i 'why|prov|trace' | sort -u | sed -n '1,200p'
env | sort | rg -i 'why|prov|trace|audit|case|workspace' || true
find .. -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path '*/.git/*' -printf '%p\\n' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'python3 -m whyfs --help
python3 -m whyfs ask --help
python3 -m whyfs ask index 2>&1 || true
python3 -m whyfs status 2>&1 || true'

/bin/bash -lc 'python3 -m whyfs ask origin reports/inventory-summary.txt
python3 -m whyfs ask sources reports/inventory-summary.txt
python3 -m whyfs label reports/inventory-summary.txt --json
python3 -m whyfs history reports/inventory-summary.txt --limit 0 --json'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 -m whyfs label reports/inventory-summary.txt
python3 -m whyfs why reports/inventory-summary.txt --json
rg -n 'inputs_hidden|hidden_inputs|hidden input|complete' /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/whyfs/{label.py,query.py,ask.py,labeltext.py,observation.py} | sed -n '1,260p'
sed -n '190,240p' /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/whyfs/label.py
sed -n '60,95p' /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/whyfs/labeltext.py
sed -n '1,210p' /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/whyfs/observation.py"
